en.title: State Council General Office issues guidelines to boost AI's positive job-creation effects and soften job displacement
en.summary: On October 23, the General Office of the State Council issued the "Opinions on Adapting to the Development of AI Technology and Supporting an Employment-Friendly Development Model," calling for strengthening AI's positive effects in creating jobs and empowering traditional roles, while effectively mitigating the job-displacement impact of AI adoption.
en.reason: China’s State Council General Office issued an October 23 opinion to boost AI’s job-creating effects, expand demand for AI trainers, prudently pace AI use in labor-intensive industries, and encourage unemployment buffer periods with advance notice and redeployment support.

sources.summary: Claude 官方宣布，下周起 Pro、Max 和 Team 套餐在 Claude 网页、桌面和移动端应用中的会话将默认以 auto mode 运行。auto mode 不再逐步请求用户批准，而是由自动检查拦截高风险操作，用户可随时切回手动模式。其引用的 Claude Code 更新提到 auto mode 用独立分类器审查 shell 命令，测试中拦截了 89% 的危险命令，手动批准为 14%。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 下周起，Claude 在 web、桌面和移动端的 Pro、Max 和 Team 套餐将默认运行 auto 模式，用自动化检查拦截风险操作，不再逐步请求批准，用户随时可切回手动。

en.summary: Claude officially announced that starting next week, sessions on the Pro, Max, and Team plans across the Claude web, desktop, and mobile apps will run in auto mode by default. Auto mode no longer asks for user approval at each step; instead, automated checks block high-risk actions, and users can switch back to manual mode at any time. The Claude Code update it cites notes that auto mode uses a separate classifier to review shell commands, intercepting 89% of dangerous commands in testing, compared with 14% for manual approval.
en.reason: Next week, Claude's Pro, Max, and Team sessions on web, desktop, and mobile default to auto mode, whose classifier blocked 89% of dangerous shell commands in tests versus 14% under manual approval, with users able to switch back.

sources.title_zh: Anthropic 股权表内幕：风投迟到多年，如今无人持股超 2%

sources.title_original: The Story of Anthropic’s Cap Table: VCs Showed Up Late to the Party, Toting All the Cash They Could Wrangle
sources.summary: Newcomer 长文复盘 Anthropic 从 OpenAI 出走团队到即将 IPO 的股权演变。据投资人文件和多位知情人士，多年来风投因公司治理结构和安全优先路线而观望，目前没有任何风投机构持股超过 2%，Anthropic 曾向投资人明确将单一投资人持股控制在该水平以避免话语权集中。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Anthropic 筹备 IPO，Iconiq、Menlo、Lightspeed 为最大风投赢家但均持股不足 2%；此前 VC 因公司结构特殊、重安全轻商业化而回避。

en.summary: In a long-form retrospective, Newcomer traces Anthropic’s equity evolution from an OpenAI breakaway team to an imminent IPO. According to investor documents and multiple people familiar with the matter, VCs stayed on the sidelines for years due to the company’s governance structure and safety-first approach; no VC firm currently holds more than 2%. Anthropic had explicitly told investors it would cap any single investor’s stake at that level to avoid a concentration of influence.
en.reason: Ahead of Anthropic’s IPO, Iconiq, Menlo and Lightspeed are the largest VC winners but each holds under 2%, a cap Anthropic set to stop any single investor from gaining concentrated influence after years of caution over governance and safety-first strategy.

sources.summary: PHP2Shell 漏洞在被披露前四天已遭黑客利用，Calif 与 Wiz 的研究人员发现这些漏洞。OpenAI 称其前沿 AI 在攻击者之前发现了漏洞，并与 PHP、Calif、Wiz 合作验证并开发补丁。NSA 建议无法立即更新的机构将系统离线，英国 NCSC 表示漏洞可能让黑客无需登录凭据即可控制网站服务器，白宫称联邦机构正在评估对政府系统和关键基础设施的潜在影响。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Amazon称黑客在PHP漏洞公开前四天已探测利用，这些由OpenAI和Google模型发现、十余年未被察觉的漏洞被Wiz估计影响约70%网站，NSA要求立即更新或下线。

en.summary: The PHP2Shell vulnerability was already being exploited by hackers four days before it was disclosed, with researchers at Calif and Wiz discovering the flaws. OpenAI says its frontier AI found the vulnerability before attackers did and worked with PHP, Calif, and Wiz to verify it and develop a patch. The NSA advises organizations unable to update immediately to take systems offline, while the UK's NCSC said the flaw could let hackers take control of web servers without login credentials. The White House said federal agencies are assessing the potential impact on government systems and critical infrastructure.
en.reason: Hackers exploited the PHP2Shell flaws four days before disclosure, and Wiz estimates the decade-old bugs — found by OpenAI and Google AI models — affect roughly 70% of websites, with the NSA urging immediate patching or going offline.
